raw_text: Segment onsets and rimes of spoken one-syllable words with blends, digraphs, and trigraphs in the initial and final positions.
competency_statement: Segment the beginning and ending sound parts (onsets and rimes) of spoken one-syllable words that include blends, digraphs, and trigraphs.
observable_behaviors: Say a one-syllable word aloud and break it into its beginning sound cluster (onset) and the rest of the word (rime).
Identify and separate blends, digraphs, and trigraphs at the start and end of spoken words.
Orally segment words into onset and rime parts, including complex consonant clusters.
skill_clauses: Segment onsets and rimes of spoken one-syllable words.
Include blends, digraphs, and trigraphs in initial and final positions when segmenting.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize onsets and rimes in spoken one-syllable words with blends, digraphs, and trigraphs.
student_actions.oral_production: Orally segment onsets and rimes in spoken one-syllable words with blends, digraphs, and trigraphs.
